 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. WNBA Finals Game 7 is the league's most expensive game of all time.
 The get-in price to see the Valkyries and Dream square off at the Chase Center is $396, according to TickPick. The matchup is the first Finals Game 7 in WNBA history.
 Golden State Valkyries guard Veronica Burton reacts after a foul during Game 4 of the WNBA basketball finals against the Atlanta Dream. AP Photo/Brynn Anderson
 Atlanta was unrelenting in Game 6 and managed to extend the series for one final showdown. Golden State will have to face the Dream once more, but in front of adoring fans at Ballhalla, which could very well play a role in fueling the Valkyries to a victory.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Dream sold out Game 6 at State Farm Arena, despite the 9:30 a.m. PT start time . There's a good chance the Valkyries do the same for Game 7, given the team's historic regular season where every home game was a sellout.
 Atlanta Dream forward Angel Reese reacts during game six of the WNBA Finals at State Farm Arena in Atlanta, Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026. IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect
 Arena view before game five of the 2026 WNBA Finals between the Golden State Valkyries and Atlanta Dream at Chase Center. IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect
 Golden State has already made history with its early success only two seasons into its existence. The organization has reached the playoffs in back-to-back seasons and will play in the first Finals Game 7 in WNBA history.
 The Valkyries run since it began play in 2025 has already been legendary, but winning the WNBA Finals would cap off one of the greatest seasons the league has ever seen.
